summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with embedded firmware experience in bare-metal C on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers, including register-level GPIO, timer, ADC and I2C drivers and FreeRTOS task coordination. Builds Python engineering tools for data acquisition, test automation and verification, including a pure-integer reference model checked against 100 golden test vectors at 99.996% agreement. Debugs firmware and system-level issues on the bench with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers, closing out 11 integration failures to reach 100% reliability.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with a Raspberry Pi over I2C and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; debugged and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Built a Python engineering tool (PyQt + Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization, used to analyze and debug instrumentation in a live laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed ARM Cortex-M4 peripherals directly in bare-metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate, verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver for real-time sensing and display.

projects.name: Quantization-Aware Training for Integer-Only Inference
bullets: Built a pure-integer reference model and exported int8 weights, scale parameters, and 100 golden test vectors to verify the deployed fixed-point path.
Verified fixed-point requantization against the float reference on 99.996% of hidden values at identical test accuracy (97.43% on the 10,000-image MNIST test set).

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on an STM32 microcontroller; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART command handling and user override, driven by YOLOv8 detections from an NVIDIA Jetson.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — M.S. Capstone, RIT
bullets: Debugged and closed out 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) to reach 100% pick reliability over 10 trials at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
